overall_assessment: NMBU extraction quality is poor across almost all sections. The h3-heading splitter consistently fails to cut at 'Dette lærer du', causing course_content to swallow the entire learning outcomes block in virtually every course; as a result learning_outcomes is absent from extractor output for ~15 of 18 courses. A secondary structural failure cascades downstream: the section assigned after 'Pensum' or 'Læringsaktiviteter' runs past its true boundary, pulling prerequisite, assessment, coursework, and administrative content into the wrong buckets. The assessment section is also systematically polluted with 'Obligatorisk aktivitet' and admin fields (Undervisningstider, Fortrinnsrett) that should be stripped.

findings.description: The extractor does not recognise 'Dette lærer du' as a section boundary, so the course_content row absorbs all content from 'Om dette emnet' straight through the Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse learning-outcomes blocks. The codebook defines course_content as subject-matter topics only; learning outcomes (what the student will know/can do) must be separated into learning_outcomes.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The h3-heading map does not include 'Dette lærer du' (or its variants) as a heading that triggers a section cut, so the parser treats it as body text of the preceding 'Om dette emnet' section.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Dette lærer du', 'Læringsutbytte', and 'Læringsmål' to the heading-to-section map, mapping them to learning_outcomes. Cut course_content at this heading.

findings.evidence: No learning_outcomes row appears in extractor output for the majority of courses, despite rich Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse blocks in ground truth.
findings.description: Because 'Dette lærer du' is not recognised as a heading, the learning outcomes are absorbed into course_content (see above finding). The canonical learning_outcomes section is consequently absent from the extractor output for ~15 of 18 reviewed courses. This is the most impactful missing-section failure in the dataset.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Downstream consequence of the missing 'Dette lærer du' heading mapping described above.
findings.suggested_fix: Same fix as course_content merger: map 'Dette lærer du' to learning_outcomes and cut there. Then emit a learning_outcomes row containing everything up to the next recognised heading (e.g. 'Læringsaktiviteter').

findings.description: The prerequisites row starts correctly with the actual prerequisite text but then continues uncut through the entire 'Vurderingsordning, hjelpemiddel og eksamen' block, KI-policy, sensorordning, and 'Obligatorisk aktivitet'. All of that belongs in assessment and coursework_requirements, not prerequisites. The codebook requires prerequisites to contain subject-matter entry requirements only.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading 'Vurderingsordning, hjelpemiddel og eksamen' (or a variant) is not recognised as a cut point when it follows 'Forutsatte forkunnskaper', so the parser keeps appending content to the prerequisites bucket.
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure 'Vurderingsordning, hjelpemiddel og eksamen' and all its variants are always mapped as a hard section boundary that terminates prerequisites and starts assessment.

findings.description: The assessment row in most courses includes the 'Obligatorisk aktivitet' block (which belongs in coursework_requirements per the codebook) and then continues into 'Undervisningstider', 'Fortrinnsrett', and 'Opptakskrav' admin fields that are pure boilerplate. The codebook specifies assessment must contain only graded final assessment design; arbeidskrav/obligatoriske aktiviteter must be separated into coursework_requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Obligatorisk aktivitet', 'Undervisningstider', 'Fortrinnsrett', and 'Opptakskrav' are not treated as cut-points after the assessment heading, so the parser keeps appending them to the assessment bucket.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Obligatorisk aktivitet' as a boundary that terminates assessment and starts coursework_requirements. Map 'Undervisningstider', 'Fortrinnsrett', 'Opptakskrav', and 'Merknader' as boundaries that terminate all content extraction (or map to a drop/admin bucket).

findings.evidence: Assessment row starts at 'Hjelpemiddelkode A2: ingen utdelt kalkulator...' (MATH100) or 'Karakteruttrykk: Bestått/ikke bestått' (PPXP100), missing the leading exam-type sentence.
findings.description: The actual exam description sentence that opens the 'Vurderingsordning' block (e.g. '3,5 timers skriftlig eksamen i Wiseflow' for MATH100; 'Emnet består av to deler som vurderes hver for seg: Praksisopplæringen...' for PPXP100) is not captured in the assessment row. The extractor begins after the first sentence. The codebook requires the full assessment design to be captured.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The splitter may be consuming the heading line itself plus one sentence into a heading node rather than body text, or the boundary-cut is placed one sentence late.
findings.suggested_fix: Verify that the full text of the section body (starting from the first content sentence immediately after the heading) is included in the emitted row, not just from the second sentence onward.

findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Undervisningstider', 'Overlapp', 'Opptakskrav', 'Merknader', and 'Fortrinnsrett' as terminators for all content sections (or route them to a drop/admin bucket).

findings.description: The teaching_methods row (mapped from 'Læringsaktiviteter') runs past its natural boundary and absorbs 'Læringsstøtte', 'Pensum', 'Forutsatte forkunnskaper', and the entire 'Vurderingsordning' block. Per the codebook, teaching_methods covers only how the course is taught; prerequisites and assessment belong in their own sections.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Læringsstøtte', 'Pensum', and 'Forutsatte forkunnskaper' may not be mapped as cut-points that terminate teaching_methods; the parser keeps accumulating text until a recognised heading appears.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Læringsstøtte', 'Pensum', 'Forutsatte forkunnskaper', and 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' as section boundaries. Route 'Læringsstøtte' to a drop/admin bucket; 'Pensum' to reading_list; 'Forutsatte forkunnskaper'/'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' to prerequisites.

findings.description: For the master's thesis courses (M30-LUN, M60-LUN), the reading_list row contains the tail end of the learning outcomes plus teaching methods, prerequisites, and the full assessment block — not any reading list content. The actual pensum text ('Undervisningsmateriell utvikles individuelt.') appears inside the reading_list row, but it is buried among ~4000 chars of misclassified material. Root cause: the extractor is triggered by 'Pensum' but cuts the section at the wrong upstream point, capturing a large block of learning outcomes text that appears before 'Pensum' in the flow.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The section labeled reading_list is not triggered at the 'Pensum' heading but rather at some earlier internal marker; the upstream split of learning_outcomes content is landing here instead.
findings.suggested_fix: Trigger reading_list extraction precisely at the 'Pensum' heading and cut it at the next heading. Do not include text from sections that precede 'Pensum' in the document.

findings.description: For PPPE301, the reading_list row contains teaching methods content ('Introduksjoner til faglige analyser...'), læringsstøtte, and then the actual pensum text ('Oversikt er tilgjengelig i Canvas') plus prerequisites. The codebook defines reading_list as required/recommended literature only. The actual pensum note is present but buried among wrongly-attributed teaching-methods and admin text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The same boundary-cut failure as in teaching_methods: 'Introduksjoner...' is part of the Læringsaktiviteter section but no cut was made before the reading_list bucket was started.
findings.suggested_fix: Same as teaching_methods fix: cut at 'Pensum' heading and extract only the content under that heading into reading_list.

findings.description: The prerequisites row contains only 'Realfag' — the programme-level admission requirement (from 'Opptakskrav'), not a subject-matter prerequisite. The codebook specifies that programme admission requirements must be excluded from prerequisites. The section is flagged 'empty' by deterministic checks, but the underlying issue is boilerplate_only: the one word present is administrative admission text, not academic knowledge prerequisite.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Opptakskrav' text is being routed to prerequisites instead of being dropped as administrative content. Alternatively, 'Forutsatte forkunnskaper' is absent in this course and the nearest text (Opptakskrav) is misclassified.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Opptakskrav' to a drop/admin bucket, not to prerequisites. Only 'Forutsatte forkunnskaper' and 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' should feed prerequisites.

findings.description: The prerequisites row contains only an administrative admission/approval requirement ('innvilges kun etter søknad til Undervisningsutvalget'). This is programme-admission boilerplate, not a subject-matter prerequisite. Per the codebook, such generic administrative content must be excluded even when it appears under a prerequisites heading.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Opptakskrav' heading is being routed to prerequisites instead of being dropped.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop 'Opptakskrav' content from prerequisites output; only extract 'Forutsatte forkunnskaper' and 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper'.

findings.description: The 'Om bruk av KI' block (AI-use policy category + link text 'Her finner du KI-kategoriene beskrevet.') and the 'Sensorordning' block (examiner arrangement) appear inside the assessment row across virtually all courses. These are administrative exam-logistics fields, not assessment design. The codebook explicitly says to exclude exam-logistics and administrative content from assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Om bruk av KI' and 'Sensorordning' are not recognised as headings to cut on, so they are absorbed into the assessment bucket.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Om bruk av KI' and 'Sensorordning' to drop/admin bucket. They are institutional boilerplate, not canonical section content.
